diff --git a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
index b38158f..0a7e6ef 100644
--- a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
+++ b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
@@ -87,6 +87,61 @@ class TestQtArgs:
         for arg in ['--foo', '--bar']:
             assert arg in args
 
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize('backend, expected', [
+        (usertypes.Backend.QtWebEngine,
+         ['--enable-features=CliOne,CliTwo,ConfigOne,OverlayScrollbar']),
+        (usertypes.Backend.QtWebKit,
+         ['--enable-features=CliOne,CliTwo',
+          '--enable-features=ConfigOne']),
+    ])
+    def test_existing_enabled_features(self, config_stub, monkeypatch, parser,
+                                       backend, expected):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.objects, 'backend', backend)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_mac', False)
+        config_stub.val.scrolling.bar = 'overlay'
+        config_stub.val.qt.args = ['enable-features=ConfigOne']
+        parsed = parser.parse_args([
+            '--qt-flag', 'enable-features=CliOne,CliTwo'])
+
+        args = qtargs.qt_args(parsed)
+        feature_args = [arg for arg in args
+                        if arg.startswith('--enable-features=')]
+        assert feature_args == expected
+
+    def test_empty_enabled_features(self, config_stub, monkeypatch, parser):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.objects, 'backend',
+                            usertypes.Backend.QtWebEngine)
+        config_stub.val.scrolling.bar = 'never'
+        config_stub.val.qt.args = ['enable-features=']
+        parsed = parser.parse_args(['--qt-flag', 'enable-features='])
+
+        assert not any(arg.startswith('--enable-features=')
+                       for arg in qtargs.qt_args(parsed))
+
+    def test_enabled_features_helper(self, config_stub, monkeypatch):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_mac', True)
+        config_stub.val.scrolling.bar = 'overlay'
+
+        assert list(qtargs._qtwebengine_enabled_features([
+            '--enable-features=One,Two', '--enable-features=Three'])) == [
+                'One', 'Two', 'Three']
+
+    def test_qtwebengine_args_features(self, config_stub, monkeypatch, parser):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_mac', True)
+        config_stub.val.scrolling.bar = 'overlay'
+        parsed = parser.parse_args([])
+
+        without_features = list(qtargs._qtwebengine_args(parsed, []))
+        with_features = list(qtargs._qtwebengine_args(
+            parsed, ['--enable-features=One,Two',
+                     '--enable-features=Three']))
+
+        assert not any(arg.startswith('--enable-features=')
+                       for arg in without_features)
+        assert [arg for arg in with_features
+                if arg.startswith('--enable-features=')] == [
+                    '--enable-features=One,Two,Three']
+
     @pytest.mark.parametrize('backend, expected', [
         (usertypes.Backend.QtWebEngine, True),
         (usertypes.Backend.QtWebKit, False),
